title: Course: CS 284A | EECS at UC Berkeley
content: Course: CS 284A | EECS at UC Berkeley CS 284A. Foundations of Computer Graphics Catalog Description: Techniques of modeling objects for the purpose of computer rendering: boundary representations, constructive solids geometry, hierarchical scene descriptions. Mathematical techniques for curve and surface representation. Basic elements of a computer graphics rendering pipeline; architecture of modern graphics display devices. Geometrical transformations such as rotation, scaling, translation, and their matrix representations. Homogeneous coordinates, projective and perspective transformations. Units: 4 Related Areas: Graphics (GR) Prerequisites: COMPSCI 61B or COMPSCI 61BL; programming skills in C, C++, or Java; linear algebra and calculus; or consent of instructor. Credit Restrictions: Students will receive no credit for Computer Science 284A after taking 184.
